svg.title: A pointer can point into the stack or into the heap
svg.desc: Two rows. In the top row, int altitude_m{120}; int* altitude_ptr{&altitude_m}; draws a stack pointer box with a blue arrow to a named stack box holding 120. In the bottom row, int* battery_pct{new int{88}}; draws the same pointer with a red arrow to an unnamed heap box holding 88.
